nodes.label: Captio Login Page Screenshot (Spanish) - Inicia sesión UI
nodes.description: Screenshot of the Captio application login page in Spanish locale. Displays a centered card UI with the Captio logo (tagline: 'intake · brief · equipo'), a heading 'Inicia sesión', a subtitle 'Acceso solo para el equipo del despacho.' (Access only for the firm's team), two input fields labeled 'Correo' (email) and 'Contraseña' (password), a blue gradient 'Entrar' (Enter/Login) submit button, and a language switcher showing ES (active/selected) and EN options. Light gray background, card has rounded corners and a soft shadow. Clean minimal design with a blue color scheme.
